remarks: Be the first to move into this beautifully and completely remodeled 2 Bedroom apartment. Located above the Norwalk Seaport Assoc. office. High ceilings, plenty of natural light. Living Room/Kitchen combination w/generous cabinet space, center island, quartz countertops, stainless appliances. Primary BR and smaller 2nd Bedroom/Office. Add a 3 season porch with back egress. Beautiful hardwood flooring throughout, recessed lighting, skylights & high ceilings. This unit is available to move-in early January. Washer & dryer in unit. Located directly across from Veterans Park and within minutes of the South Norwalk train station, shops, restaurants, Beer Garden & nightlife, the Maritime Aquarium & Museum in Sono and all of East Norwalk amenities -  Beaches, restaurants, Mr. Frosty's. It's a lifestyle living in this Norwalk walk to water community.   A Boaters delight with the City of Norwalk Marina & Boat launch ramps at Vets Park.. A commuter's delight. Short walk to the South Norwalk Train Station, Minutes to I-95 & Merritt Pwy.  Must have good credit. Two months security deposit required. Parking is paid by Tenant, additional $26.59/Month.  ]Submit all applications through Rentspree.
